name: @edam/verifier
description: Independent evidence verifier (EDAM-T140 skeleton): public-inputs-only. Pure package importing only @edam/canonical + vendored schemas (@edam/contracts) + @edam/evidence + node:crypto public-key/cert parsing. Re-proves evidence from a WORM read port or an export package. No writer / signing-private / anchoring / DB import. Verification logic lands in T141-T144.
